description: Cencora, formerly AmerisourceBergen, is a global pharmaceutical-solutions company that sources, distributes, and supports prescription drugs, specialty medicines, over-the-counter products, medical supplies, and related services. Its U.S. Healthcare Solutions segment serves health systems, hospitals, physician practices, pharmacies, and other care sites through pharmaceutical distribution, specialty distribution, supply-chain, and pharmacy solutions. Cencora also provides biopharma and life-sciences services—including clinical-trial logistics, market access, regulatory support, commercialization, and patient-support services—and operates in more than 50 countries.

title: Cencora

rankings.title: Fortune Global 500
rankings.itemDescription:
The global wholesale drug distributor saw its revenue grow 11.5% in its most recent fiscal year, while profits rose by 10.3%.

  • Revenue in the company’s international health care solutions segment grew 130%, to $26.5 billion, reflecting its recent acquisition of Alliance Healthcare.

  • Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) played a role in monkeypox vaccine distribution efforts, receiving a $19.8 million contract from the Biden administration in September 2022 to help distribute doses.

rankings.title: Fortune Global 500
rankings.itemDescription: Drug distribution giant AmerisourceBergen fell four spots on the Global 500 from last year. Like its large rivals in the business, the company continues to wrestle with lawsuits regarding its alleged role in the opioid crisis while enduring criticism from shareholders. Still, revenue increased by 12.7% to $214 billion for the fiscal year ended September 2021. AmerisourceBergen also unveiled a new global headquarters in Conshohocken, Pa.

rankings.itemDescription: The Pennsylvania-based pharmaceutical distributor moves up two spots on this year’s list; its revenues grew 5.7% in its last fiscal year, which ended in September 2020, owing to increased volume and higher prices of the medications it delivers to pharmacies across the country. The company’s veterinary division also recorded solid growth. Like other drug wholesalers, AmerisourceBergen faces legal challenges over its alleged role in America’s opioid epidemic.

rankings.title: Fortune Global 500
rankings.itemDescription: The second largest drug distributor in the U.S. held steady on this year’s list with 6.9% revenue growth in its 2019 fiscal year, driven primarily by strong sales of pricey specialty drugs. Profits were down due to impairment charges taken on PharMEDium, the company’s troubled compounding unit; AmerisourceBergen announced it was shuttering the business earlier this year. Like its competitors, AmerisourceBergen faces thousands of lawsuits and a federal criminal investigation over its alleged role in the nation’s opioid epidemic. States rejected a proposed $18 billion settlement with the three major drug wholesalers in February.
